A Brazilian dictionary has added “Pelé” as an adjective to use when describing someone who is “exceptional, incomparable, unique.” The announcement by the Michaelis dictionary on Wednesday, April 26, 2023, is part of a campaign that gathered more than 125,000 signatures to honor the late soccer great’s impact beyond his sport. (AP Photo, File)

In this aerial view trees stand on the forest property where US automaker Tesla is to build a new Gigafactory on January 21, 2020 near Gruenheide, Germany. Tesla and the state of Brandenburg recently sealed the sale of the property, located near Berlin, to Tesla.
